text:
Omar (Sales): Passing off Celandine Health — signed 12mo Dedicated. PoC good, exec sponsor engaged. Sending to CS for onboarding & compliance run.

Omar (Sales): Quick snapshot: DPA signed, procurement wants PHI isolation + KMS/HSM timeline. They aim for go-live in ~28 days.

Omar (Sales): Technical asks: Okta SAML+SCIM, VPC peering (preferred window 01:00-04:00 UTC), private model mount for PHI evals, capacity plan for 4 rps steady / 9 rps spikes.

Priya (CS): Ill lead onboarding. Owners: Priya (onboarding), Hannah (enablement + docs), Jon (support/runbook & pager), Ravi (infra/peering), Devin (smoke tests).

Priya (CS): Pre-kickoff asks for Sales: customer SSO metadata, public ASN, preferred peering days, and expected hourly traffic curve.

Omar (Sales): Contact: infra@celandinehealth.com (Marta). ASN 65555 (confirmed). Preferred peering Tue/Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Ravi (Infra): Need CIDR allowlist + any NAT requirements. HSM ETA for Dedicated tenants ~6 weeks; KMS customer-managed keys available now. We'll provide a compliance note for procurement.

Devin (Solutions): I'll prep a 12-prompt smoke set (short/long/few-shot) and a small test harness. Example curl for their infra team post-SSO:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.us.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \\
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-dedicated","input":"Test latency"}'
```

Hannah (CS PM): Enablement plan: 45m live session + recording, 1-pager with cutover criteria, and a short checklist for AM/engineers. I'll post draft by EOD tomorrow.

Jon (Support): I'll open ticket CLD-410 "Celandine onboarding" and add checklist: SSO verify, SCIM provisioning, peering validation, model mount verification, smoke tests, canary cutover, and oncall rota for first 30d.

ticket-bot: Ticket CLD-410 created by Jon (Support) - https://support.redwood.ai/CLD-410

Priya (CS): Action items (owners):
- Priya: schedule kickoff + weekly checkpoints (owner)
- Ravi: validate VPC peering config + CIDRs and post HSM/KMS note (owner)
- Devin: upload smoke tests + harness to /shared/celandine (owner)
- Jon: create CLD-410 runbook & oncall rotation (owner)
- Hannah: deliver enablement 1-pager + recording (owner)

Priya (CS): Renewal risk note: procurement may delay if HSM not available within 45 days; add to risk register.

Ravi (Infra): I'll run a staging capacity test tomorrow and post p95 numbers to CLD-410. Preliminary: ~210-250ms p95 @512 tokens with continuous batching on a40-class.

Jon (Support): Oncall thresholds I'll set: page on error-rate >1.5% or p95 >400ms during first 14 days. I'll link escalation path in CLD-410.

Omar (Sales): Customer asked for a conditional credit clause: 9% if p95 >300ms for first 60d. Legal ok'd a conditional credit; flagging for CS risk register.

Hannah (CS PM): Success criteria we'll track: go-live <=28d, p95 <300ms steady, SSO+SCIM functional, smoke pass, zero Sev1 first 14 days. I'll add to the enablement doc.

Devin (Solutions): Uploaded smoke CSV + python harness to /shared/celandine-tests. Will attach expected pass thresholds.

Ravi (Infra): Staging results posted to CLD-410: 230ms p95 @512 tokens, baseline QPS 6 with continuous batching. Graphs attached.

Priya (CS): Great handoff. Kickoff scheduled Thu 15:00 UTC; I'll send invite and agenda. Owners please update CLD-410 daily until cutover.

Jon (Support): Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/celandine-onboarding-runbook - please review and comment.

Omar (Sales): Thanks team  I'll join kickoff and introduce the customer AM. :handshake:

Priya (CS): Closing: tracking in CLD-410; primary success metric = go-live within 28 days with p95 <300ms and no Sev1 in first 2 weeks.
